summary: 55-year-old male from Aurora fell at the top edge of a snowfield while descending Mount Sherman and twisted his lower leg; Flight for Life flew him to University of Colorado Hospital, where he underwent surgery.
responding_agency: Park County SAR, Flight for Life
notes: Had climbed Mount Quandary that morning before summiting Sherman; 1 a.m. call, flown out around 6 a.m., expected release June 25.
